name: Neocaridina shrimp
notes: A small colony, so every loss is proportionally significant. Investigate any death rather than writing it off as attrition.

name: Fancy guppy
notes: Sex ratio unknown. If mixed, fry within weeks and a compounding bioload in a tank with no nitrate export.

name: Suckermouth catfish
notes: Otocinclus or juvenile pleco - not established which. Alone, and Otocinclus are shoaling animals needing 5-6+. A common pleco reaches 30 cm and would outgrow this tank entirely. The belly check is the only health signal available.

name: Albino mystery snail
notes: Adults are commonly given 2.5-5 gal each, which is the core of the overstocking problem in a four-gallon tank.

name: Red Racer nerite
notes: Grazes biofilm only. The tank is planted, so there is real grazing surface, but a young setup carries thin biofilm and every grazer competes for it.

notes: On a 3-4 week molt clock, in the tank with the lowest GH.
